description: Writes up to 100 records. Each operation is one step; the result gives the ids of created records.

id.description: The record's id. update and associate need id or key; upsert may give either.

key.description: Alternate key values by column, instead of id.

values.description: Column logical names mapped to values. Plain strings, numbers, booleans and null are plain; other types are {"$type":"EntityReference","logicalName":"account","id":"<guid>"}, {"$type":"OptionSetValue","value":1}, Money, DateTime, Decimal, Double, Guid.

relationship.description: associate: schema name of the relationship.

key.description: Alternate key values by column, instead of id.

allOrNothing.description: Run every operation in one transaction: all are applied or none. Default false: stop at the first failure.
